explanation: An editorial shortlist chosen by Baseline: widely used model families, each with its app, a current general-purpose model and its newest public release. It is not a measured popularity ranking, and it is not a list of models Baseline has tested. Every other model stays in the full directory below.

groups.reason: OpenAI's model page lists GPT-6 Astra as its flagship; GPT-6.1 Sol is its newest release (29 Sep 2026). gpt-oss-120b is OpenAI's open-weight model as served by Groq, a separate host: not ChatGPT and not OpenAI's own API.
Claude Sonnet 5.5 (28 Sep 2026) and Claude Opus 5.5 (22 Sep 2026) are Anthropic's newest models on its models overview.
Gemini 3.8 Flash (2 Sep 2026) is Google's newest listed Flash model; Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite is the route Baseline already tests.
deepseek-v4-pro and deepseek-flash are the two model IDs on DeepSeek's current pricing page.
Qwen3.8-Max and Qwen3.8-Flash are the newest entries in Alibaba Model Studio's release table.
Llama 4 is Meta's current open-weight family; Meta AI is Meta's app. No exact Llama API version is verified here.
grok-4.7 (21 Sep 2026) is the newest model on xAI's developer model list.
